items.title: Metadata-Block ChoiceA-D +1 Offset on Certified Items
items.learner_safety_impact: HIGH — 58 Certified Pack A items. Learners see distractor explanations about wrong topic when they select wrong answers.

current_state.scope: Pack A Sections B, C, F (Certified). Pack A Section E already remediated S805 (57 items). Possible Pack C/D dual-block sections.
current_state.root_cause: Template-based bulk authoring produced paired-object structure per QID: metadata block (ChoiceA-D, ExplanationWrongA-D) + content block (Choices.A-D, CorrectChoice, ExplanationCorrect). Metadata blocks carry stale template residues from original authoring pipeline — shifted by +1 position in the rotation group.
current_state.verification_methodology: Per DEFECT_LIBRARY.md DL-016: extract both metadata-block ChoiceA-D and content-block Choices.A-D. Compare. If different → DL-016 confirmed.
current_state.DL-029_risk: HIGH — any forward-scan methodology will produce false positives because metadata-block CC may differ from content-block CC. Must use within-object boundary-aware extraction.

items.classification_rationale: Active learner-safety risk on 58 Certified items. Must be remediated before any further Pack A certification waves. This is a correctness-of-feedback issue — learners receive wrong-topic explanations on wrong answers.

execution_plan.approach: Per-item metadata-to-content alignment. For each affected item: (1) extract content-block Choices.A-D (authoritative — what the learner sees), (2) verify each ExplanationWrong[X] field in the metadata block describes the content-block Choice X, (3) if not: rewrite ExplanationWrong[X] to match the item's actual distractor, (4) if yes: leave intact.
execution_plan.pre_requisite: S217 execution (Rule 1 BLOCK upgrade, cross-registry reconciliation). Without Rule 1 BLOCK, certification changes cannot be traceably audited.

option_a_recommended.action: Archive 112 clone items (set question_state: 'Archived'). Retain 28 seed items as active (question_state: 'Unprocessed' — ready for certification).
option_a_recommended.clone_qids: Groups 1-28: the 4 non-seed items in each group (112 total). Seeds: one item per group selected for best educational quality (28 total).
option_a_recommended.seed_selection_criterion: Select the item in each group with the most substantive ExplanationCorrect and choice-specific ExplanationWrong fields (typically the 'Difficult'-labeled item in each group).
option_a_recommended.post_archival: 28 seeds ready for CAQS §1.6 six-dimension certification. 112 clones preserved but excluded from learner pool (content not deleted — per Constitution §7: 'AI SHALL NOT delete questions').
option_a_recommended.impact: Reduces Section E population from 150 items to 103 items (28 seeds + 75 non-clone items). Removes 93.3% clone waste.

option_b_alternative.action: Re-key all 140 items with UniqueConceptKey to distinguish them. Keep all active.
option_b_alternative.impact: Preserves item count but requires 140 metadata updates + 112 distractor explanation rewrites.
